# ghost/stoic-reading

Stoic Reading (F-Droid): the classic Stoic texts offline (Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Seneca and more), open an author, a work and a book, and read it. No account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/stoic-reading
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/stoic-reading open_library --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/stoic-reading list_works --device <serial> --param author=<author>
ghost skill run ghost/stoic-reading open_work --device <serial> --param author=<author>
ghost skill run ghost/stoic-reading read_text --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_library`: Open the Stoic Reading app
- `list_works`: What works does Seneca have in Stoic Reading?
- `open_work`: Open Meditations Book 2 by Marcus Aurelius
- `read_text`: Read the text on screen in Stoic Reading
